',
  7:"data:image/webp;base64,",
  8:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
  9:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
  10:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
};

  function renderLevelGrid(){
    const grid = document.getElementById('levelGrid');
    grid.innerHTML='';
    LEVELS.forEach((lv, idx)=>{
      const unlocked = TEST_ALL_LEVELS || state.progressData.unlocked >= lv.id;
      const data = state.progressData.levels[lv.id] || {stars:0,best:0,completed:false};
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = `level-card ${!unlocked?'locked':''}`;
      if(LEVEL_CARD_ART[lv.id]) btn.style.setProperty('--card-art', `url(${LEVEL_CARD_ART[lv.id]})`);
      else btn.style.background = cardGradient(lv.theme);
      btn.innerHTML = `
        <span class="badge">${unlocked?`Niv. ${lv.id}`:'🔒'}</span>
        <div class="card-copy">
          <h3>${lv.name}</h3>
          <p>${lv.desc}</p>
          <div class="mini-stars">${renderSmallStars(data.stars)}</div>
        </div>
      `;
      btn.disabled = !unlocked;
      btn.addEventListener('click', ()=> startLevel(idx));
      grid.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }
  function renderSmallStars(count){
    let html='';
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++) html += `<span style="color:${i<count?'#ffd12f':'rgba(255,255,255,.38)'}">★</span>`;
    return html;
  }
  function cardGradient(theme){
    switch(theme){
      case 'sunset': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#ffb05e,#ff7f88,#7e68ff)';
      case 'storm': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#536f9d,#344f72,#1d3555)';
      case 'deepstorm': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#334969,#1d2e49,#102334)';
      case 'night': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#3556a2,#1f376d,#172854)';
      case 'snow': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#bee6ff,#8ad6ff,#63b8f0)';
      case 'aurora': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#25558e,#274e81,#1ca38d)';
      case 'vortex': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#45228f,#2f2967,#1a274d)';
      case 'boss': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#7038b7,#aa4266,#3c2960)';
      case 'garden': return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#60cd76,#4ac3b2,#4da4ff)';
      default: return 'linear-gradient(135deg,#42c5ff,#65ddff,#4ed3b5)';
    }
  }

  let pendingLevelStart = null;
  function startLevel(idx){
    if(Number.isInteger(idx) && idx>=0 && idx<LEVELS.length){
      state.progressData.lastLevel=idx;
      saveProgress();
    }
    if(idx===6&&!level7AssetsReady()){
      pendingLevelStart=idx;showToast('Chargement HD niveau 7…');
      preloadLevel7HD().then(ok=>{if(pendingLevelStart!==idx)return;pendingLevelStart=null;if(!ok)showToast('Mode compatible activé');resetLevel(idx,'adventure');});return;
    }
    if(idx===5&&!level6AssetsReady()){
      pendingLevelStart=idx;showToast('Chargement HD niveau 6…');
      preloadLevel6HD().then(ok=>{if(pendingLevelStart!==idx)return;pendingLevelStart=null;if(!ok)showToast('Mode compatible activé');resetLevel(idx,'adventure');});return;
    }
    if(idx===3&&!level4AssetsReady()){
      pendingLevelStart=idx;showToast('Chargement HD niveau 4…');
      preloadLevel4HD().then(ok=>{if(pendingLevelStart!==idx)return;pendingLevelStart=null;if(!ok)showToast('Mode compatible activé');resetLevel(idx,'adventure');});return;
    }
    if(idx===2&&!level3AssetsReady()){
      pendingLevelStart=idx;showToast('Chargement HD niveau 3…');
      preloadLevel3HD().then(ok=>{if(pendingLevelStart!==idx)return;pendingLevelStart=null;if(!ok)showToast('Mode compatible activé');resetLevel(idx,'adventure');});return;
    }
    if(idx===1&&!level2AssetsReady()){
      pendingLevelStart=idx;showToast('Chargement HD niveau 2…');
      preloadLevel2HD().then(ok=>{if(pendingLevelStart!==idx)return;pendingLevelStart=null;if(!ok)showToast('Mode compatible activé');resetLevel(idx,'adventure');});return;
    }
    if(idx===0&&!level1AssetsReady()){
      pendingLevelStart=idx;showToast('Chargement HD…');
      preloadLevel1HD().then(ok=>{if(pendingLevelStart!==idx)return;pendingLevelStart=null;if(!ok)showToast('Mode compatible activé');resetLevel(idx,'adventure');});return;
    }
    pendingLevelStart=null;resetLevel(idx,'adventure');
  }
  function showMap(){ renderLevelGrid(); setScreen('map'); }
  function goHome(){ refreshHomeScore(); setScreen('home'); }


  function refreshOptions(){
    const easy=state.difficulty==='easy';
    document.getElementById('modeEasy').classList.toggle('active',easy);
    document.getElementById('modeNormal').classList.toggle('active',!easy);
    document.getElementById('difficultyInfo').textContent=easy?'Mode facile : tu peux être touché 2 fois avant le Game Over.':'Mode normal : un choc termine la partie.';
  }
  function setDifficulty(mode){
    state.difficulty=mode==='easy'?'easy':'normal';
    state.progressData.difficulty=state.difficulty;saveProgress();refreshOptions();showToast(state.difficulty==='easy'?'Mode facile activé':'Mode normal activé');
  }

  // Buttons
  document.getElementById('openOptions').onclick = ()=>{refreshOptions();setScreen('options');};
  document.getElementById('closeOptions').onclick = goHome;
  document.getElementById('modeNormal').onclick = ()=>setDifficulty('normal');
  document.getElementById('modeEasy').onclick = ()=>setDifficulty('easy');
  document.getElementById('playAdventure').onclick = ()=> startLevel(0);
  document.getElementById('goLevels').onclick = showMap;
  document.getElementById('backHomeFromMap').onclick = goHome;
  document.getElementById('playEndless').onclick = resetEndless;
  document.getElementById('resetProgress').onclick = ()=>{
    const idx=clamp(Number(state.progressData.lastLevel || 0),0,LEVELS.length-1);
    startLevel(idx);
  };

  document.getElementById('backMap').onclick = ()=> { state.running=false; showMap(); };
  document.getElementById('pauseBtn').onclick = ()=>{ if(state.running){ state.paused = true; setScreen('pause'); }};
  document.getElementById('resumeBtn').onclick = ()=>{ state.paused = false; setScreen('play'); };
  document.getElementById('restartBtn').onclick = ()=>{ state.paused=false; state.mode==='endless' ? resetEndless() : startLevel(state.levelIndex); };
  document.getElementById('pauseToMap').onclick = ()=>{ state.paused=false; state.running=false; showMap(); };
  document.getElementById('replayBtn').onclick = ()=> startLevel(state.levelIndex);
  document.getElementById('completeToMap').onclick = showMap;
  document.getElementById('deadToMap').onclick = showMap;
  document.getElementById('retryDead').onclick = ()=> state.mode==='endless' ? resetEndless() : startLevel(state.levelIndex);
  document.getElementById('nextLevelBtn').onclick = ()=>{
    if(maybeShowUnlock()) return;
    const next = Math.min(LEVELS.length-1, state.levelIndex+1); startLevel(next);
  };
  document.getElementById('continueUnlocked').onclick = ()=>{ const next = Math.min(LEVELS.length-1, state.levelIndex+1); startLevel(next); };

  // Input
  function pointerPlay(){
    if(state.screen==='play') flap();
  }
  app.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e)=>{
    if(e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('button')) return;
    if(state.screen==='play') { e.preventDefault(); pointerPlay(); }
  }, {passive:false});
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if(e.code==='Space' || e.code==='ArrowUp' || e.code==='KeyW'){
      if(state.screen==='play'){ e.preventDefault(); flap(); }
    } else if((e.code==='Escape' || e.code==='KeyP') && state.screen==='play'){ state.paused=true; setScreen('pause'); }
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', ()=>{
    if(document.hidden && state.screen==='play' && state.running){ state.paused=true; setScreen('pause'); }
    state.lastTick = performance.now();
  });

  window.NuageNomadeDiagnostics = Object.freeze({
    assetsReady: () => level1AssetsReady(),
    allCoreAssetsReady: () => [level1AssetsReady(),level2AssetsReady(),level3AssetsReady(),level4AssetsReady(),level5AssetsReady(),level6AssetsReady(),level7AssetsReady()].every(Boolean),
    version: 'levels-1-to-10-hd-audited',
    levelCount: LEVELS.length,
    testAllLevels: TEST_ALL_LEVELS
  });
  renderHeroPreview();
  renderLevelGrid();
  refreshHomeScore();
  goHome();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<script>
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && location.protocol === 'https:') {
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('./service-worker.js', {scope:'./'}).catch(console.warn);
  });
}
</script>

</body>
</html>
